answers.question: I'm a freshman in aerospace, not mechanical engineering. Can I join, and how do I sign up?
answers.text: Yes. ASME OSU is especially focused on mechanical engineering, but students from related engineering majors and anyone interested in design, manufacturing, robotics, energy, aerospace, automotive, or professional development are welcome. First-year students are encouraged to join early. Sign up for the email newsletter for full announcements and join the ASME OSU GroupMe for quick reminders and day-of updates.ASME OSU newsletter signupThis form signs you up for the ASME OSU email newsletter.
